title: Paris Travel Vlog | Louvre, Versailles Palace, Opera Ballet, Luxury Shopping & More 🇫🇷
description:
finally made it to Paris — and it did NOT disappoint! In this Paris travel vlog, I'm taking you along for my very first time exploring the City of Light. From standing in awe inside the Louvre Museum, to the grandeur of the Palace of Versailles, catching a breathtaking ballet at the Paris Opera House (Palais Garnier), and indulging in luxury shopping on some of the most iconic streets in the world — this trip was absolutely unforgettable.
Whether you're planning your first trip to Paris or just dreaming of one, this vlog covers it all!
